title: Travel Completed | Delay Below Threshold (<2h) | Code 64 Crew Shortage | APPR | Basic Aeroplan
goal:
Flight AC 364 YUL?YYZ operated but arrived 1 hour 45 minutes late due to Code 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable). The 1h 45m delay falls well below the APPR minimum qualifying threshold of 3 hours, making the passenger NOT ELIGIBLE for compensation. Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210) linked to the booking. Validates that: (1) DDS correctly identifies that the delay exists and has a valid controllable code (Code 64), (2) DDS applies the APPR 3-hour minimum threshold gate and fails the claim because 1h 45m < 3h, (3) NOT ELIGIBLE result is returned even though the delay is controllable, (4) AC Wallet is NOT offered as no compensation is payable, (5) Basic Aeroplan profile is recognized but does not affect eligibility outcome.

Prerequisites
PNR: TC051 � single passenger V�ronique Gagnon (Adult - Basic Aeroplan Member). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 364, YUL?YYZ (domestic). Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 15:45 (1h 45min delay, 105 min). Arrival delay code: 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable, available, no fallback). Delay: 1h 45min (105 min � below APPR 3h minimum threshold). Regime: APPR (domestic). Booking changes: None. Timing: >72hrs elapsed. Filing: Within 366 days. Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. CyberSource: NOT invoked (not eligible). RDS: No flags.
